title: The Confessional
text: A confessional booth stands alone in a burned church, untouched by the fire that blackened everything around it. Its curtain stirs. A warm, patient voice inside invites confession, and it seems to know already what each of you might say.

options.label: Each Scion steps behind the curtain and confesses, hoping to be unburdened.

outcomes.text: A weight lifted, and the voice says nothing at all, kindly.
The voice listens, and thanks them, and tells it to someone else. They hear it being retold, faintly, as they leave.

options.label: Each Scion listens to the others' sins instead, and keeps their own counsel.

outcomes.text: Other people's sins, whispered through the curtain, and useful ones to know.
